standards_review.note: `EPMCDME-10913: Deprecate ZephyrSquad integration (UI)` matches project convention.
eslint clean; tsc --noEmit clean; gitleaks clean.
No credential-value paths altered; deprecation is presentational + guard-only.

findings.problem: Filtering `deprecated` out of getCredentialUIMapping breaks the edit view. SettingsForm's CREDENTIAL_VALUES_MAPPING is derived from getCredentialUIMapping and is the source of truth for field rendering, defaults, and mappingExists. With ZephyrSquad filtered out, mappingExists=false and the form renders the 'Not implemented yet 😔' fallback in place of the credential fields on every existing ZephyrSquad Edit page.
findings.impact: Existing ZephyrSquad settings become unviewable — the deprecation banner shows above a broken form. Direct regression of AC3/AC4 for existing users.
findings.recommendation: Move the `deprecated` filter from getCredentialUIMapping (rendering) to getAvailableCredentialsTypes (picker list) so both concerns are satisfied.

findings.problem: The useEffect redirect fires after the first render, so users see a visible flash of the new-integration form before navigation.
findings.impact: Minor UX defect; users may briefly interact with a form that is about to be discarded.
findings.recommendation: Compute isDeprecatedRequested at render time and return null before rendering the form (keep useEffect for navigation).

findings.problem: NewProjectIntegrationPage lacks the URL guard that NewUserIntegrationPage has. Although the page does not currently read query.credentialType, adding a symmetric guard matches spec AC2 ("redirects or blocks") and prevents drift if the page later starts consuming the query param.
findings.impact: Inconsistent behavior between user and project scopes.
findings.recommendation: Mirror the isDeprecatedCredentialType guard from NewUserIntegrationPage.

rationale: Multi-lens review returned 3 patchable findings across all three lenses: one critical rendering regression (CR-001, edge-case lens) caught before merge, plus two minor UX consistency issues (CR-002 blind, CR-003 acceptance). Non-blocking findings (T6 fields-disabled scope trim, blind #4 message-type-untyped false-positive since CredentialMessage type already exists, blind #5 casing false-positive since lookup lowercases correctly, edge-case notes on autocomplete display name unaffected) triaged to dismiss/defer with reasoning. Decision: request-changes — CR-001 is a hard regression blocker. CR-002/CR-003 bundled in the same fix-up. AC4 field-disable stays out of scope: Save+Test are the only mutation paths, both hidden; a follow-up MR can add field-level disabled if UX asks. Total blocking findings: 1 critical + 2 major.
